tools.name: quote_video
tools.description: Returns the credits a video of this kind and length costs and the account's balance. Free, and nothing starts. Needs a Pro or Business plan. A 3D film is priced per started minute, so the answer's seconds is the longest it may run for that price (15 s asked = up to 60 s).

tools.name: make_video
tools.description: Starts a video in the user's AIVideo.day account from a written brief: script, voices, pictures or 3D characters. Spends the user's credits, at most max_credits, so get the price from quote_video and the user's agreement first. Returns video_id and render_url. The server writes the video; the MP4 fi

tools.name: get_video
tools.description: Returns where one of the user's videos stands (writing, needs_browser, rendering, ready or failed), its render_url until the file exists, and video_url when the MP4 is ready. Free.

tools.name: list_my_videos
tools.description: Lists the user's latest videos, newest first: id, title, when it last changed, and the MP4's address once it has one. Free.
